measurement_groups.description: Partition of term indices (0-based) into groups of simultaneously-measurable Pauli observables. Each inner array sorted ascending. Use the minimum number of groups.

selected_scale_factors.description: Chosen noise amplification factors, sorted ascending. Must be a subset of available factors from the database, with count within the allowed extrapolation range.

extrapolation_weights.description: Coefficients for polynomial extrapolation to the zero-noise limit, ordered to correspond to selected_scale_factors. The extrapolated value is the weighted sum over measurements at each scale factor.

minimum_variance.description: Minimum achievable total estimation variance for the Hamiltonian expectation value with optimal shot distribution.

shot_allocation.description: shot_allocation[g][j] = number of shots for measurement group g at scale factor j. Dimensions: [num_groups x num_scale_factors]. Must sum to total_shot_budget.
